svg.title: DAMA–FAIR Sankey v1.3.0
svg.desc: 13 DAMA areas and topics map to 15 FAIR principles through 74 proposed alignments: 52 direct and 22 enabling or indirect. Big Data and Data Science and Data Handling Ethics are additional topics beyond the 11 core knowledge areas. Equal ribbon widths represent mappings, not strength or compliance.

g.text: 11 core knowledge areas + 2 additional topics → 15 FAIR Data Principles
